fields.field: TCA9539 PW pin map verified against TI; address 0x74 candidate. Port 1 (pins 13-20, P1.0-P1.7): IMU_INT, RTC_INT_N, SOFT_KILL, unused, POWER_INT_N, FN_N, HAPTIC_EN, COVER_N; P1.3 (pin 16) is not connected (no layout path from the charger on the far side of the board): firmware reads the charge state from the BQ25798 status registers over I2C; configure P1.3 as an input. Order set by the layout: the lines leaving south take pins 13-17 in the order they reach their parts.

property.name: Design note
property.value: TCA9539 PW pin map verified against TI; address 0x74 candidate. Port 1 (pins 13-20, P1.0-P1.7): IMU_INT, RTC_INT_N, SOFT_KILL, unused, POWER_INT_N, FN_N, HAPTIC_EN, COVER_N; P1.3 (pin 16) is not connected (no layout path from the charger on the far side of the board): firmware reads the charge state from the BQ25798 status registers over I2C; configure P1.3 as an input. Order set by the layout: the lines leaving south take pins 13-17 in the order they reach their parts.
